scope: Read and semantically receive actual completed browser download bytes; no product module import, browser execution or repeated production tests.
negativeControls: Score-preserving wrong canonical first-choice swap across two trace records
Score/grade-count-preserving first-choice text swap across two note question blocks
Practice tuple reorder preserving the item set, six answers and six correct retries
immutableAdmission: Explicit expected browser-receipt and learner-demo SHA256 values; eight downloaded hashes/lengths checked; source-before/after maps exact; course/companion/parser/UI/driver source pins explicit.
oracleIndependence: Correct canonical choices come from the sealed blind question-only solve, before authored key disclosure. Explanations and transfer text come from separately reviewed immutable course source. Per-item semantic checks use recorded UI interaction IDs and canonical choices, not production reducer/exporter functions.
negativeAdmissionBoundary: Fault controls run only on in-memory clones after raw artifact admission. They must fail specified semantic identity checks; input hash mismatch cannot be the rejection reason.
historicalSourceBoundary: Original v3 browser packet is exact 8b-based learner on e8ea product. A current-main packet requires a separately declared demo and receipt pin; old runtime claims are not relabeled.
limitations: Model values are checked for preservation, not independently recalibrated. Educational efficacy is not claimed.
